# RoleRover

> RoleRover is an AI job search and application assistant for people who want help finding relevant roles, tailoring ATS-friendly resumes and cover letters, and automating repetitive job-application work.

## Public pages

- [Home](https://myrolerover.com/): Product overview, supported roles and countries, pricing, and frequently asked questions.
- [Privacy Policy](https://myrolerover.com/privacy.html): How RoleRover handles user data.
- [Terms of Service](https://myrolerover.com/terms.html): Terms governing use of RoleRover.
- [Refund Policy](https://myrolerover.com/refunds.html): Refund terms.

## Product summary

RoleRover helps users discover relevant jobs, match opportunities to their preferences, tailor resumes and cover letters, automate job applications, and manage application tracking. It is relevant for searches about AI job search assistants, automated job applications, AI resume tailoring, ATS resume optimization, personalized job matching, AI cover letters, and job search automation. Users should review the product's current terms and privacy policy before signing up.
